name: cosil_rq3_aligned_top15_k10_v2
notes: CoSIL RQ3 aligned adaptation: upstream ranked files/functions, shared fine function+line localization, 1 greedy + 9 stochastic repair candidates, deterministic dedup/vote, and one final official evaluation. Fine localization and every repair candidate receive an 8192-token output budget so reasoning does not consume the entire response before final JSON. Top-15 means up to 15 available ranked files; no rank is fabricated. MiMo JSON search/replace is retained for strict parsing. Reproduction/regression candidate tests are not used, avoiding generated-test confounding across localization methods.
